title: I left my bag on the bus
instructions: Omar otobüste unuttuğu çantası için kayıp eşya bürosunu arıyor. Çantanın tarifine dikkat et.

script.speaker: office
script.text: Lost property office. Can I help you?

script.speaker: omar
script.text: Yes, please. I left my bag on the number fifteen bus this morning.

script.speaker: office
script.text: What time were you on the bus?

script.speaker: omar
script.text: At about half past eight. I got off at the university.

script.speaker: omar
script.text: It's a black backpack. There's a laptop and two notebooks inside.

script.speaker: office
script.text: Just a moment. Yes, we have a black backpack from the number fifteen bus. Is there a name in it?

script.speaker: omar
script.text: Yes, my name is on the first notebook. Omar Hassan.

script.speaker: office
script.text: That's it. You can collect it today, before five o'clock.

questions.evidence: on the number fifteen bus this morning.
I got off at the university.

questions.feedback: Çantada bir dizüstü bilgisayar ve iki defter var.
questions.evidence: There's a laptop and two notebooks inside.

questions.prompt: When can Omar collect the bag?
questions.evidence: You can collect it today, before five o'clock.
